versions.changelog: Automated follow-up queries, quality scoring, source dedup, batch research mode, 3 output formats

Initial release of the claw-web-research skill.

- Automates structured web research with source-cited reports.
- Supports freelance research, competitive and market analysis, technical deep-dives, and fact-checking.
- Workflow includes question parsing, web searching, content fetching, synthesis, citation, and storage.
- Enforces quality guidelines: source cross-checking, citation, flagging outdated info, and distinguishing opinion from data.
- Requires web_search, web_fetch, write, and exec tools.
- Outputs reports in standardized Markdown format with executive summary, findings, citations, and limitations.
